Anchors are zero-based runtime pixel coordinates from top-left. Door marks the threshold; foot marks the bottom-center sorting point. This metadata file is the single source of building collision. Collision rectangle is the opaque sprite rows in 16px ground tiles; roof overhang and transparent padding are not collision. The map entity's footRow anchors the sprite bottom, not the collision rect. Map owner must place a walkable portal immediately in front of the door. Art reviewed at 1x and 4x; approval covers sprite export, not in-game map integration.

Map asset pack 2 (#93) townsfolk walk sheet. Rows down,left,right,up; columns idle,stepA,stepB (same layout as char-player). Artist notes: Six separate generated sources. Export via per-cell alpha bounds, common aspect-preserving nearest-neighbour scale per character, bottom-centre alignment, <=32 RGBA colors, binary alpha. Columns idle/stepA/stepB; rows down/left/right/up. Child is shorter. No repo edits. Transparent row gaps determine slice boundaries because generated row spacing is uneven. Reviewed final exports at 1x and 6x; distinct alternating poses and accessories remain legible. Raw numbering maps to salaryman, student, tourist, elder, child, runner respectively.

Three generated themed sheets sliced in IT index order. All surfaces use full square source cells, never stretched from opaque bounds. Furniture alpha threshold 128. Paired display and kotatsu halves cropped to alpha bounds and fitted to 16x14 to remove source spacing. Index 47 transparent. Runtime export uses nearest-neighbour, hard alpha and 24-color quantization. Surfaces v4 is an Image Gen 2 edit of v3 to simplify grain at 16px. WALL_TOP uses a square crop of the generated walnut cap. See export.tiles for measured crop coordinates.

Agent visual review at 1x and 4x. Fixed T indices 0..31; 32..47 transparent. Tree quadrants 17,18,19,20 reconstruct one 32x32 tree. Collision remains map-owned. Source v1 generated, v2 edited to remove tree seams and improve ground. Crop boxes remove generated gutters and ground borders. Palette sampled from generated source regions to retain green, red, blue, cream, brown and slate; visually matched against building references. Manifest and loader integration belongs to #1. Export source is the assembled 128x96 atlas (built from rawSource via export.cropBoxesByRuntimeIndex); tools/art/export.mjs re-quantizes it 1:1.

Map asset pack 2 (#93) road/park/nature add-on tiles, 8x4 of 16x16, indices row-major 0..31. Trees: sakura 14-17 and autumn 18-21 are TL,TR,BL,BR quadrants of a 32x32 tree. Collision remains map-owned. Artist notes: Three built-in Image Gen 2 outputs. raw-v2 ground/traffic source; raw-v3 corrected full trees sliced into four quadrants each. Nearest-neighbour export, 31 RGB palette entries plus transparency, hard alpha. Ground full-cell; grass/water perimeter strips assembled from palette-matched existing outdoor base cells; drain grate assembled over existing sidewalk. Repeatable brick/gravel/water opposite borders use copied source strips. Native and 6x visual review; 4x4 repeats and base joins included as PNG contact sheets. Brick mortar is sparse at runtime scale. Ground color continuity checked visually; road curves use a wider curb shape than existing straight edges, so map assembler should review their curb transitions. Requested git pull failed with shared FETCH_HEAD corruption; no repo files edited.
